issues.claim: "Its page titles name both towns; its pages publish Lakewood."
issues.problem: Over-broad as written: only the home page <title> (and its og:title) names both towns; sub-page titles are generic ("First Rehab Therapy : Location", "... : About us", "... : Schedule An Appointment"). What names both towns site-wide is the meta description, which appears on every page fetched. The substance of the point (site markets Spotswood, publishes Lakewood) holds.
issues.fix: Reword to: "Its home page title and every page's meta description name both towns; its pages publish Lakewood."

claims_checked.claim: Two New Jersey clinics - Lakewood and Spotswood
Spotswood listing at 404 Main St #A, Spotswood, NJ 08884, phone (732) 251-6640, 'Located in: Quality Urns and Statues for Less'
Six clinicians on the staff page (Baruch Gottlieb, Rachel Gobioff, Tzipora Reinman, Sora Schonfeld, Karen/Chany Tischler, Malky Wilschanski)
Baruch Gottlieb, DPT, listed as Clinical Director
Spotswood listing shows 5.0 from 10 reviews, category occupational therapist, website first-rehab.com, 'Closed - Opens 8 AM Mon'
The Spotswood listing links to first-rehab.com (email/opener claim: 'sends people to first-rehab.com')
Page sitemap has 15 pages and no Spotswood location page
Site publishes Lakewood only: 1352 River Avenue Unit 3, Lakewood NJ 08701, 732.884.2020 (fax 732.200.0954), Mon-Thu 8:30-6/5, Fri 8-1:30, 'Hours are subject to change. Please call to confirm.'
Header call button on every page dials the Lakewood number (tel:+17328842020 / 732.884.2020)
"Its page titles name both towns"
Page metadata names both towns (home title 'Physical / Occupational Therapy Lakewood & Spotswood, NJ'; meta description naming Spotswood & Lakewood on home, locations, schedule and about pages)
Scheduling form asks for diagnosis and referral source, shows no availability, depends on a callback
Form's Location dropdown offers only 'Lakewood'
Insurance verification routed to the phone ("call us at 732.884.2020 ... verify your insurance benefits")
FAQ says patients typically attend 2-3 times a week for 4-8 weeks, sessions about an hour
No booking engine, patient portal or messaging/live-chat visible (static pages plus Contact Form 7 forms only)
Visible Spotswood reviews are old (rendered reviews 4, 4 and 7 years ago; newest visible about 4 years old)
No location-specific structured data (Organization JSON-LD carries only name, url, logo and a LinkedIn sameAs)
A duplicate Google listing exists for the same town ('First Rehab Outpatient Therapy Provider Spotswood', no reviews)
An unclaimed directory profile exists (Birdeye: 'This profile has not been claimed by the business owner', 5.0 from 11 reviews)
Dental Assistant median wage, New Jersey, May 2023 = $22.50/hr
Physical Therapist median wage, New Jersey, May 2023 = $50.00/hr (mean annual $109,280)
Benefit multipliers presented as the audit's own assumption: $22.50 x 1.25 = $28.12; $50.00 x 1.25 = $62.50
Opportunity 2 arithmetic: 480-1,200 patients/yr x 10-15 min x 50-70% = 40-210 hours (480x10x0.5/60 = 40; 1,200x15x0.7/60 = 210)
Opportunity 2 dollar range: 40 x $28.12 = ~$1,125 and 210 x $28.12 = ~$5,905, matching 'about $1,120-$5,900 a year'
Opportunity 3 arithmetic: 2-5 missed visits x 2 clinics x 52 weeks x 1 hour x 9-39% = ~18-203 hours, reported as 18-202
Opportunity 3 dollar range: 18 x $62.50 = $1,125 and 202 x $62.50 = $12,625
Benchmark behind the 9%-39% band: model-based text reminders median RR 0.91 (high certainty), phone-call reminders median RR 0.61 (moderate certainty), patient navigators RR 0.55
The audit's cited PubMed URL (pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/36508503/) serves the abstract
Email/opener: Spotswood listing points to first-rehab.com, which has no Spotswood page, address, hours or phone, and the booking form offers Lakewood only
Named contact Baruch Gottlieb, DPT, Clinical Director is published by the practice itself (no private-individual data used)
Audit body length at most ~450 words (measured ~460 including headings)
